N1-executed-150-approved-120-verdict-say.what: A2 requests and attempts a specification of 150.00 EUR where 120.00 was approved; the auditor's verdict still states executed_as_approved: the re-run gives not_as_approved

N2-evidence-bytes-altered-after-citation.what: one member of A2 changed after the verdict cited it (observed succeeded -> failed): no item held has the cited digest

N3-no-container-writer-signature-absent.what: the record's bytes arrive without a container: no key shown to bind them to the writer (Wright Section 3)

N4-container-signed-by-a-key-not-the-wri.what: the container names the writer's key reference but the signature is another key's

N5-record-not-in-canonical-form.what: a space after the first comma: re-serializing the parsed record does not give the same bytes (Section 2.1)

N6-a-member-this-document-does-not-defin.what: a member 'note' added to the record (Section 2.2: no other member is allowed)

N7-judgement-on-a-check-run.what: rule judgement on a record of kind check-run, which the checker's policy does not list for judgement (step 1)

N8-evidence-format-not-in-the-checkers-p.what: the checker's policy does not list the action-binding format: the items are held but not relied on (step 2)

N9-pointer-does-not-resolve.what: the attempted digest is bound to /stages/9/spec_digest; A2 has seven stages (step 3 FAILs, not a result of the rule)

N10-an-input-copied-into-body-under-an-e.what: attempted_spec_digest copied into body instead of bound to A2; the checker reads inputs from evidence only (Section 4.5): step 3 NOT RUN

N10b-the-same-copy-under-the-default-pol.what: the same record under the default policy: released, the report naming the input read from body (Section 4.2, Section 4.4). Expected by Wright's text, not a failure: it shows what the evidence-only policy adds

N11-the-verdict-cited-by-the-closing-dec.what: the closing decision names the digest of a verdict record whose act_time is one second later than the one held: the DPS checks of the closing decision verify (they do not read the citation), the join does not

N12-version-2-supersedes-a-digest-of-not.what: version 2 names another digest in supersedes: the steps of Section 4.3 do not read supersedes, the record is released; the join on the pair does not hold

N13-version-2-with-supersedes-null.what: version 2 with supersedes null (Section 2.2: for a later version, the digest of the previous version): refused before any step

N14-a-verdict-citing-a-refused-verdict-r.what: a reassessment record cites, under the format verdict-record/1, the verdict of N1 (refused): the cited record is checked as a record of its own and is not released, so step 2 is NOT RUN (Section 4.3, Section 6)

N15-a-verdict-citing-a-verdict-beyond-th.what: the same reassessment over the released verdict of part A, the checker's policy following citations to depth 0: step 2 NOT RUN

N16-container-binds-the-bytes-to-a-party.what: the container is signed by a key the anchors bind to other-audit.example and names that party; the record's writer is audit.example (Wright Section 3: the key must be shown to belong to the party the record names in writer): held

N17-body-nested-to-exactly-32-levels.what: body carries an object chain making the record exactly 32 levels deep (record, body, 30 objects; Wright's vector a11): Section 2.1 refuses only deeper than 32, so released (until 6 November 2026 this checker refused it, off by one)

N18-body-nested-to-33-levels.what: the same chain one object longer, 33 levels (Wright's vector a12): refused before any step
